text:
alex: Heads up — eu-west rack B3 showing 99th-tail latency spikes for dedicated slices (gpu-ded-az2). Pattern looks like egress bursts from a single tenant. Can someone confirm noisy neighbor vs egress slot exhaustion?
maria: Seeing it on the dashboards too. Slice eviction counts spike and NIC tx queues keep growing.
joel: Is this related to the rack-reservation policy we rolled last week? We reserved per-rack egress for dedicated pools, right?
alex: Yeah. We set ~20% per-rack reserved egress for dedicated to guarantee isolation. B3 keeps hitting that and then things pile up — suspect the reserve accounting is off when multi-slab hosts are present.
maria: I pulled flow logs. Repeated requeue/drop entries with ~30s burst windows. Rough snippet: TX_DROP bursts at t=1719812360..1719812390.
sre-bot: Alert: dedicated-slices-high-tail-latency eu-west B3 — incident created #INC-2342
joel: Impact on customers? Any SLA breaches?
alex: No hard SLA breach yet but 99th token latency ~2.3x for some dedicated tenants in Bronze tier. If this persists, we'll cross our latency SLO.
maria: Short-term workaround: reduce rack egress reservation to 10% for B3? That risks host-level contention but might relieve the queuing.
joel: Another low-risk option: throttle heavy egress flows at the top-of-rack proxy to smooth bursts for a few minutes.
alex: Also looks like routing controller is pinning a bunch of preemptible backfills onto the same NICs — I'll check controller logs.
maria: If we throttle at proxy, need to notify sales/customer success. Dedicated customers expect isolation guarantees.
joel: Proposed immediate plan: 1) temp proxy throttle to smooth bursts, 2) patch routing controller to spread backfills across NICs/racks, 3) audit reservation accounting for multi-slab hosts. Owners?
alex: I'll own (2) — will open a PR.
maria: I'll kick off the proxy throttle and monitor.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: started runbook throttle-proxy/eu-west/b3 by maria at 1719812405
joel: I'll run the reservation accounting audit and post findings here.
alex: PR queued: #7890 controller: use rack-aware hashing for backfill placement.
joel: Audit quick win: found double-counting in reserve calc for mini-slices on multi-slab hosts. Opening ticket to fix.
maria: After starting the throttle, 99th dropped ~40% in ~2m. Watching a 5m window now.
alex: Good recovery. Postmortem item: ensure reservation telemetry is per-NIC and we expose per-rack egress utilization to ops.
joel: Also flagging cost/product impact: if we widen reserved headroom to be safer, unit costs for dedicated customers change. Will loop in product.
maria: Noted. I'll keep monitoring and update this thread with the incident timeline and metrics.
alex: Thanks — will follow up with PR link and controller logs when ready.
